answer_1.quote: We develop a Foreground Designer that creates blueprints for banner assets with engaging content and harmonized styling ... CPYQ Evaluates the effectiveness of the headline, subheadline, and any other text in the banner ad, focusing on clarity, readability, persuasiveness, and grammatical correctness.
answer_1.outputs: Banner designs containing textual copy (headlines, subheadlines, body text, CTA) together with visual components

answer_2.quote: We developed six metrics (Tab. 1) from extensive literature survey on banner design principles.

answer_3.quote: We conducted a human-LLM correlation study validating the alignment between GPT-4o's automated scoring and human perception across six proposed metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conducted three human evaluations to assess different aspects of BannerAgency. First, a system preference study with 20 participants comparing banner designs; second, a refinement effectiveness evaluation where 15 participants rated quality progression across iterations; third, a human-LLM correlation study.
answer_4.guideline: Participants compared banner designs, rated each design on a 5‑point scale for the six quality metrics, and indicated preferences between system variants.
